label: Tree
short_definition: A woody perennial plant with a main trunk that supports branches and leaves.
interpretation_hint: A strong tree signal points to taller woody structure and possible canopy influence in the cluster.

label: Shrub
short_definition: A woody plant smaller than a tree and usually with several stems from the base.
interpretation_hint: A shrub signal points to lower woody structure rather than a tall single-trunk canopy.

label: Chamaephyte
short_definition: A plant with persistent buds or shoots close above the soil surface.
interpretation_hint: A chamaephyte signal points to low near-ground woody or subshrub structure.

label: Epiphyte
short_definition: A plant that grows on other plants rather than rooting in the soil.
interpretation_hint: An epiphyte signal should be read as substrate-dependent growth rather than ordinary soil-rooted structure.

label: Geophyte
short_definition: A plant that survives the unfavorable season with buds or storage organs below ground.
interpretation_hint: A geophyte signal points to seasonal dieback with underground persistence.

label: Hemicryptophyte
short_definition: A perennial plant with resting buds at or just above the soil surface.
interpretation_hint: A strong hemicryptophyte signal points to persistent herbaceous or grass-like ground-layer structure.

label: Phanerophyte
short_definition: A plant with resting buds carried well above the soil surface, typically as a tree or shrub.
interpretation_hint: A phanerophyte signal points to woody above-ground persistence through the unfavorable season.

label: Therophyte
short_definition: An annual plant that survives the unfavorable season as seed.
interpretation_hint: A therophyte signal points to short-lived seasonal or disturbance-tolerant structure.
